title: Take the k smallest
prompt: Return the k smallest numbers of values, from smallest to largest. When values has fewer than k numbers, return all of them in order. Leave values unchanged. Do not sort: use the supplied heapAdd(heap, value) and heapTake(heap), which work on a min-heap held in an array.
hints: How do you get a heap that holds all the numbers?
Start with an empty array and call heapAdd for every number.
Then call heapTake up to k times, stopping early when the heap is empty.

rules.name: sort
rules.message: Use the heap. Do not call sort.

checkLabels: The two smallest of 5, 1, 4, 2, 3 are 1 and 2.
Asking for none gives an empty array.
Asking for more than there are gives all of them.
The array you were given must not change.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Returns the first k numbers as they are.
Takes k times even when the heap has run out.

feedback: Each heapTake gives the smallest number that is left. Check what happens when k is larger than the number of values.
